screening_decisions.reason: This is a pre-emptive strategy based on biomarker detection (beta-D-glucan), not untargeted prophylaxis. Treatment was given only to patients with elevated BDG levels, making it targeted rather than untargeted.
RCT comparing prophylactic antifungal agents (clotrimazole, ketoconazole, nystatin) vs no therapy in non-neutropenic critically ill surgical and trauma patients. This is untargeted prophylaxis.
RCT comparing single-dose fluconazole vs placebo in patients with intra-abdominal perforations. This represents untargeted prophylaxis in critically ill surgical patients.
RCT comparing enteral fluconazole vs placebo for prophylaxis in critically ill surgical ICU patients. This is untargeted antifungal prophylaxis.

This study evaluates antifungal treatment in patients with clinical suspicion of VAP AND positive Candida cultures in airway secretions. This is targeted treatment based on microbiological evidence, not untargeted prophylaxis.
RCT comparing SDD (including amphotericin B) vs standard care in critically ill patients. While SDD is a broader strategy, it includes untargeted antifungal prophylaxis component.
This is a pre-emptive strategy based on corrected colonization index monitoring, not untargeted prophylaxis. Treatment was triggered by specific risk markers.
This is a literature review, not an RCT. Also focuses on lung transplant recipients which may have different immune status considerations.
This is a retrospective matched case-control study validating prediction rules, not an RCT evaluating antifungal prophylaxis.
This is a systematic review, not an RCT. Also focuses on neonates/infants rather than adult critically ill patients.
This is a prospective cohort study evaluating colonization patterns, not an RCT of antifungal prophylaxis.
RCT comparing empirical vs preemptive antimycotic therapy in critically ill patients. The control group received empirical (untargeted) therapy from day of inclusion.
This is a prospective surveillance study analyzing epidemiology and resistance patterns, not an RCT of antifungal prophylaxis.
This is a pre-emptive strategy based on BDG biomarker monitoring, not untargeted prophylaxis. Treatment was triggered by positive BDG tests.
This is a study developing a scoring system for organ dysfunction, not an RCT of antifungal prophylaxis.
This is a consensus guideline document, not an RCT.

RCT comparing ketoconazole vs placebo in septic critically ill patients. Although the primary outcome was ARDS prevention, ketoconazole has antifungal properties and this represents untargeted administration.
This is a surveillance study analyzing species distribution and resistance patterns, not an RCT of antifungal prophylaxis.
This is a meta-analysis, not a primary RCT.
This is a retrospective study analyzing time delays in diagnosis, not an RCT of antifungal prophylaxis.
This is a clinical practice guideline, not an RCT.
RCT comparing caspofungin prophylaxis vs placebo in high-risk critically ill adults. This is untargeted antifungal prophylaxis.
RCT comparing SDD (including amphotericin B) vs standard care in mixed ICU patients. Includes untargeted antifungal component.
This is a retrospective economic analysis, not an RCT of antifungal prophylaxis.
This is a retrospective study developing a prediction rule, not an RCT of antifungal prophylaxis.
RCT comparing fluconazole vs placebo in critically ill patients with septic shock. This is untargeted antifungal prophylaxis.
This is a cost-of-illness analysis, not an RCT of antifungal prophylaxis.
This is a systematic review and meta-analysis, not a primary RCT.
RCT comparing garlicin, fluconazole, and control in patients with severe acute pancreatitis. This represents untargeted antifungal prophylaxis.
This is a matched case-control study, not an RCT of antifungal prophylaxis.
RCT comparing fluconazole vs placebo for prevention of intra-abdominal candidiasis in high-risk surgical patients. This is untargeted antifungal prophylaxis.
This is a consensus conference document defining sepsis terms, not an RCT.
RCT comparing oral amphotericin B vs placebo in selected ICU patients. This is untargeted antifungal prophylaxis.
This is a prospective surveillance study, not an RCT of antifungal prophylaxis.
RCT comparing protocol-based pre-emptive therapy vs proven infection treatment. The treatment group received early empiric (untargeted) therapy based on risk factors.
RCT comparing antibiotic prophylaxis including amphotericin B vs controls in mechanically ventilated patients. Includes untargeted antifungal component.
This RCT evaluated ketoconazole for treatment of established ALI/ARDS, not for prophylaxis of fungal infections. The intervention was for anti-inflammatory effects.
This is a meta-analysis, not a primary RCT.
This is a systematic review, not an RCT. Also focuses on neonates.
This is a prospective observational study, not an RCT of antifungal prophylaxis.
This is a nationwide surveillance study, not an RCT of antifungal prophylaxis.
This is a systematic review focusing on children, not an RCT of prophylaxis in adult critically ill patients.
This is a retrospective cohort study analyzing treatment timing, not an RCT of antifungal prophylaxis.
This is a meta-analysis focusing on cancer patients after chemotherapy, many of whom are neutropenic.
RCT comparing empirical fluconazole vs placebo in adult ICU patients at high risk for invasive candidiasis. This is untargeted antifungal prophylaxis.
This is a meta-analysis focusing on liver transplant patients, not a primary RCT.
RCT comparing fluconazole plus SDD vs placebo plus SDD in mechanically ventilated ICU patients. This is untargeted antifungal prophylaxis.
This is a systematic review, not a primary RCT.
This is a retrospective cohort study analyzing impact of treatment delay, not an RCT of prophylaxis.
This is a meta-analysis, not a primary RCT.
This is a systematic review focusing on cancer patients with neutropenia, which is outside the scope of non-neutropenic critically ill patients.
This RCT focuses on neonatal and pediatric ICU patients, not adult critically ill patients.
This is an economic analysis, not an RCT of antifungal prophylaxis.
This is a pilot open-label study without randomization to control group. It's a feasibility study, not a proper RCT.
This is a point prevalence observational study, not an RCT of antifungal prophylaxis.
This is a prospective autopsy study, not an RCT of antifungal prophylaxis.
This is a clinical practice guideline, not an RCT.
This is an observational study comparing diagnostic tests, not an RCT of antifungal prophylaxis.
RCT comparing ketoconazole vs placebo for prevention of yeast colonization/invasion in critically ill surgical patients. This is untargeted antifungal prophylaxis.
This is a retrospective cohort study analyzing outcomes, not an RCT of antifungal prophylaxis.
This is a review of diagnostic tests, not an RCT of antifungal prophylaxis.
This RCT focuses on peritoneal dialysis patients with bacterial peritonitis, not general critically ill patients. Different population.
This is a multicenter observational study, not an RCT of antifungal prophylaxis.
This is a single-center observational report on resistance emergence, not an RCT of antifungal prophylaxis.
This is a retrospective analysis of surveillance data, not an RCT of antifungal prophylaxis.
This is a prospective cohort study, not an RCT of antifungal prophylaxis.
RCT comparing oral nystatin vs no nystatin in ventilated ICU patients. This is untargeted antifungal prophylaxis.
This RCT compares two formulations of amphotericin B for TREATMENT of confirmed/suspected Candida infection, not for prophylaxis.
RCT comparing oral nystatin vs control in surgical/trauma ICU patients. This is untargeted antifungal prophylaxis.
This is a review article, not an RCT.
